purpose: Backward symbolic isolation of finite predictive moment discrepancies; no new fitting or estimator changes
populations: Original two construction and two heldout populations plus exact regeneration of all four saved natural-refit batches at each prefix
probes: All thirteen saved boundary/rest/load/reversal probes, unchanged
decomposition: Boundary voltage + OCV shift + terminal ohmic term + three carried RC terms + three forced RC terms + carried/positive/negative hysteresis terms; retain every covariance
comparisons: Exact term sum against inherited recurrence
Exact mean and full covariance decomposition
Equal-charge reversal closed form and zero OCV shift
Directional hysteresis amplitude inverse/Jacobian and response equivalence
Physical-rate transformed prior curvature versus actual prior constants
Existing conditional second-moment residuals without refitting
decision_rule: Rank signed mean and variance contributions; do not infer latent conditional causation from an additive partition or select a model by heldout improvement. Derive prospective reformulations only.
limits: Finite source samples are not exact posterior truth
Population and draw ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals
No streaming, aging, coverage or deployment qualification
Source prior is a density reference, never new independent evidence
